ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Preventive Visit — Ernest Shackleton

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Periodic adult preventive visit before a long expedition. [S]

Mr. Shackleton is a 47-year-old expedition leader with chronic coronary disease, a drug-eluting stent in the proximal left anterior descending artery placed six weeks ago, nicotine dependence in early remission, hyperlipidemia, and prediabetes, who comes for a preventive visit about five weeks before his expedition sails. He has had no chest pain since the stent and is going to cardiac rehabilitation three times a week. He has not smoked for almost three months and still takes varenicline. He drinks two drinks at most on four evenings a week. He takes aspirin, clopidogrel, atorvastatin, ezetimibe, and metoprolol every day and carries nitroglycerin, which he has not needed since the procedure. He wants to leave with his prevention up to date and his affairs in order. [S]

Follow-up: Pre-departure review in four weeks with an exercise test, lipids, HbA1c, and the influenza vaccine. Screening results through the patient portal. Travel medicine this week. Next scheduled visit 2026-09-08: four-month review before departure: exercise test, lipids, HbA1c, and the expedition medical plan. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent, because he will be weeks from a hospital. He named a health care agent and a second agent, and a health care proxy form was completed; both are recorded in the chart and are not named here. He wants full treatment, including resuscitation, if he becomes ill at sea, treatment aboard first with evacuation when it is possible, and he wants the expedition to continue if he cannot. He asked that a copy travel with his cardiac summary. The plan will be revisited on his return or after any serious illness. [S]
